firmware.name: v17
firmware.notes: Fixes 'replay' errors from v16: Studio text, picture and map show on the robot again, and lyrics in other scripts are drawn again. The app's page and the phone player no longer get in each other's way.

firmware.name: v16
firmware.notes: The app and the robot now talk encrypted: pairing by a key exchange (the code, the password and the token never travel), every command and answer encrypted and sealed against replays. Someone on the same WiFi learns nothing. Android phones need the Mochi app 1.8 for the phone player and robot updates.

firmware.name: v15
firmware.notes: Each robot now makes its own random WiFi password for its own WiFi and setup hotspot (it used to be mochi1234 on every robot). After this update the robot's WiFi has a new password: it is on the robot's screen and in the app under Settings -> Connection.

firmware.name: v14
firmware.notes: A new update screen: UPDATING, an hourglass that runs and turns over, the bar and 'Your robot is getting better' (on the robot and in the app, from the next update on). The Music tab's time bar can now be dragged to jump anywhere in a Spotify song.

firmware.name: v13
firmware.notes: Bot chats: each robot now shows only what it says itself, so two bots side by side read like a conversation; the app no longer needs a Show on robot button. The app guide now waits until the password offer after pairing is closed.

firmware.name: v12
firmware.notes: Faces has its own tab again. A short guide shows new users around the app the first time (again from the menu or Settings). Includes the buzzer (v11) and everything in v10.

firmware.name: v11
firmware.notes: Sound: the buzzer on GPIO0 rings the focus timer, beeps the stopwatch like a Casio, chimes for notes, popups and charging, clicks for the button, and Ring robot finds it. Settings, Sound: buzzer kind (passive, active, active low), volume, quiet at night. Includes everything in v10.

firmware.name: v10
firmware.notes: Lyrics: one big line, Bangla stays in Bangla letters, faster and in better time. Three watch faces, focus timer, stopwatch and calendar (3 clicks). Pictures and maps on the screen, note fonts, 1000 daily notes. Works with the phone player of app 1.4.

firmware.name: v9
firmware.notes: The robot now sleeps at 3.00 V (it says Charge me first), and the app warns below 3.25 V. Bot Engineers' robot logo in the app.

firmware.name: v8
firmware.notes: Lyrics in Bengali and other languages: the robot writes Bengali and Hindi in Latin letters, and with the app open it shows any script. The app finds lyrics the robot missed, and the robot keeps the lyrics of its last 6 songs. Daily notes now come only from the robot; the app sets the time.

firmware.name: v7
firmware.notes: Synced lyrics for Spotify songs (Music > Show lyrics). Check for updates now installs updates by itself. A new elegant look in Bot Engineers' style; Retro stays as a theme. The music screen no longer keeps counting when WiFi drops. YouTube Music and updating from a file are removed.

firmware.name: v6
firmware.notes: Updates now come from the Mochi update page and must carry Bot Engineers' signature. After an update the robot reconnects by itself. The charger wire (TP4056 CHRG to GPIO3) is found automatically; Robot info shows it.

app.notes: Talks to robots on firmware v16 encrypted (the sealed link): the phone player and robot updates keep working with v16. Robots on older firmware still work.
Robot updates from the app now show a full-screen update: UPDATING, an hourglass that runs and turns over, the bar and 'Your robot is getting better'.
Fixes the welcome: it shows once on a new phone, then the app goes straight to finding Mochi. The robot list and the address box take taps again after the welcome.
A short welcome on the first start, then Mochi's own app guide. Keeps the guide done when the robot moves to a new address.
Phone player: Spotify on this phone shows on Mochi, offline too, and the robot's button controls it. New Time tab, pictures and maps in Studio, lyrics sync and version picker, smoother taps.
Bot Engineers' robot logo as the app icon, on black.
A new elegant look in Bot Engineers' style that follows your phone's light or dark mode, with a new icon.
The app now tells you when there is a robot or app update and installs it with one tap. ⋮ → Updates lists every version, older ones too.
